author: agent:validation-engineer

conditions: Acceptance is withheld until the billing run completes inside the overnight window on the target.

checks.name: Schema objects reconcile between source and target

checks.method: Connection test from each application host using the production identity
checks.name: Every confirmed consumer connects to the target
Security configuration matches policy
checks.tolerance: Zero deviations without an approved exception

checks.method: Restore into an isolated environment and verify
checks.name: Restore from backup succeeds
checks.observed: Restore completed in 38 minutes, counts reconciled
checks.tolerance: Restore completes and row counts reconcile

checks.method: Execute the billing run against the target and compare elapsed time
checks.name: Overnight billing run completes within tolerance of baseline
checks.notes: The regression concentrates in the history archive queries. Root cause not established at the time of the decision.
checks.observed: 5 h 25 m, completing at 06:25, a 48% regression past the 06:00 constraint

checks.method: Exercise the dispatch integration with the agreed test set
checks.name: Invoice dispatch integration succeeds end to end
checks.observed: 13 of 14 passing; dispatch acknowledgement callback timed out

checks.method: Per-table row count and column checksum comparison
checks.name: Billing history row counts and checksums reconcile
checks.notes: Comparison had completed 22 of 38 tables when the rollback decision window closed. Partial reconciliation is not reconciliation.

checks.method: Auto-generated comparison of stored procedure outputs
checks.name: Generated procedure comparison suite
checks.notes: Supporting evidence only. A generated suite cannot substitute for the business validation that was not reached.
checks.tolerance: Identical results for every generated case

checks.method: Formal acceptance recorded as an approval artifact
checks.name: Business owner accepts the outcome
checks.notes: Not reached. The rollback decision was taken before acceptance was sought.
checks.tolerance: Approval recorded by the business owner

rollback_reason: Billing run latency regression exceeded the agreed tolerance and one blocking integration test failed. Data reconciliation had not completed when the rollback decision window closed.
